item.title: MCP TypeScript SDK v2 Released with Split Packages and Standard Schema Support
item.description:
MCP TypeScript SDK v2 Released with Split Packages and Standard Schema Support

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) TypeScript SDK has released version 2 on its main branch, implementing the 2026-07-28 MCP specification with a new split-package architecture and updated schema handling.

Source: modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk
